references.text: Debir is mentioned as one of the cities in the coalition against Gibeon, which Joshua later attacked.
Joshua's conquest of Hebron, which took place just before the attack on Debir, shows the same pattern of military campaign.
Debir is again mentioned as one of the cities where Joshua destroyed the Anakites.
Debir (formerly called Kiriath-sepher) was conquered by Othniel, showing the city's further history after Joshua's initial conquest.
Parallel account of the conquest of Debir by Othniel, showing that the city had to be reconquered after Joshua's death.
The king of Debir is listed among the defeated kings, confirming Joshua's victory over the city.
